observations.what: The module docstring makes extensive claims about evaluation flow, but this chunk contains only constants and guards; the claims cannot be verified here.
_git_read checks the verb against READ_ONLY_REPO_VERBS, but the actual allowlist contents are imported from another module and not visible.
_safe_join has an absolute-path fast path that raises OverlayEscape, but the docstring claims the containment check is the real guard; the code confirms the containment check is present.
The chunk defines STATUS_MISSING but PROVEN_NOT_PASSING excludes it, which is consistent with the comment that missing refutes the task rather than demonstrating a bug.
The function _git_in_worktree is truncated at the end of the chunk; its full behaviour cannot be assessed.
